Rexall is not a drug manufacturer (pharmaceutical company). It is a major retail pharmacy chain and drugstore brand. It dispenses prescriptions, sells over-the-counter health items, and provides health services, but it does not research or produce pharmaceutical drugs. [](https://www.rexall.ca/)

- Operates as a prominent retail pharmacy network with hundreds of locations across Canada.

- Owned by [McKesson Corporation](https://investor.mckesson.com/news/financial-news/2016/McKesson-Receives-Regulatory-Approval-for-Rexall-Health-Acquisition/default.aspx), a large healthcare services and pharmaceutical distribution company.

- Focuses on patient care, prescription fulfillment, and everyday health and wellness products. [](https://www.rexall.ca/)

### Historical Context

- Started in 1903 as a cooperative of independent drug stores under the United Drug Company.

- Historically manufactured and sold its own line of remedies, vitamins, and goods under the Rexall name.

- Evolved over decades away from manufacturing into purely a retail pharmacy and drugstore business. [](https://www.rexall.ca/)
